analyst_view.overall: NEC (12th, 7 points) and Rennes (17th, 6 points) are both in the play-off places and a win would push either toward the top eight. NEC lost 4-1 at home to PSV on Saturday, with Dick Schreuder saying his side brought too little energy, and their defence is thin: Bram Nuytinck is out, Perr Schuurs and Geiger are doubtful, and Philippe Sandler and Deveron Fonville had problems last week; the numbers take Schuurs off on the scoring side but count none of the defensive gaps. Rennes are four without a win, the latest 1-1 at Lorient, and Franck Haise is under pressure; top scorer Esteban Lepaul came back from an ankle sprain as a substitute but L'Equipe says he is not yet fully fit, captain Valentin Rongier is a doubt and Frankowski is out (counted). Both sides play in the league three days later, and Serbian referee Nenad Minakovic (about 3.9 cards a game) is in charge.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.4 goals and already take about 9% off NEC for Schuurs, who is in fact only doubtful. They do not see that NEC's back line is missing Nuytinck and possibly Sandler and Fonville after shipping four to PSV, so I lean a little higher, to about 3.5; Lepaul not being fully fit keeps the lean small.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.5 corners, already adjusted for NEC winning more corners lately (38 in six) and Rennes fewer. Nothing in the team news changes how either side builds attacks, so I stay at 9.5.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.9 cards, with referee Nenad Minakovic slightly below average (3.9 a game) and Rennes's calm recent card count already in. Both teams need the points but neither has a heated history with the other, so I stay at 3.9.

shots.text: The numbers say 29.1 shots, already raised for NEC's busy recent shooting (105 in six). A thin NEC defence could let Rennes shoot more, but possible rotation on both sides before the weekend pulls the other way, so I stay at 29.1.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 10.4 shots on target. With NEC's makeshift back line likely to give Rennes cleaner chances, I lean slightly higher, to about 10.7.
